The ardour of Ekushey
2015-02-23T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/arts-entertainment/event/the-ardour-ekushey-3368

The Amar Ekushey Book Fair bustled with an extra bit of buzz on Ekushey (21st) February, as people of all walks of life thronged the fair. Not all of them were there to buy books, though. Be it shopping for jewelry and toys, posing for portrait sketches or kids enjoying carnival rides, the festivities took a bigger dimension.
